description: Walden Pond USGS cover chart. Source contours reviewed manually; registration fitted to the cached map shoreline, not independent geographic survey control.
corrections: Closed short printed-label gaps on the 20 m middle-basin contour and other labelled paths.
Confirmed unlabeled intermediate values by counting the printed 2 m intervals between labelled paths.
Excluded the isolated 8 m shoal and two 16 m shoal fragments whose immediate enclosing path has the same value; this simplified example does not resolve those features.
Excluded small legend/stroke fragments; no extra bottom or summit depths were invented.
limitations: Geographic controls are derived from a source-shoreline fit to the cached HydroLAKES outline, not surveyed control points. The fit is approximate and its zero control residual is not an accuracy result.
This is a manually reviewed, simplified chart example. It is not a complete reproduction of every shoal, an automatic-tracing benchmark, or an independently scored depth-accuracy result.
The terrain workflow retains an incomplete chart-coverage warning. No physical fabrication was tested.
